first_handback:
Report: /private/tmp/murmuration-w04/author-w04-2/runs/u-a1/lab/__reports__/wave-04/explorer-w04-ua1/00-findings_v0.md. It has 90 table rows, one per file (file name, station name, founding year, founder), all CHECKED. All 90 files were read in order, one file per call, except f022 and f023, which I read in two parallel calls by mistake. The content was unaffected.

The 90 files hold only 58 distinct station names, so 32 files reuse a name with a different year and founder. Examples: Quillhaven in f019, f034 and f041; Slateford, Tarnstead, Wrenmoor and Quillgate each appear three times. I reported each file as written and did not merge or resolve the repeats.

Not extracted, because not requested: elevation, population, occupation and wind interval.
